description: Privileged interception of the Forward compose flow for embedded message/rfc822 S/MIME containers. When a user forwards such a message, the compose-type is redirected to a Reply before the compose window is created, so only a single reply window opens (no Forward-window flash) carrying the full decrypted content.

functions.name: getEnabled
functions.description: Whether the Forward->Reply interception is currently active.

functions.name: setEnabled
functions.description: Enable or disable the Forward->Reply interception.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: True to intercept, false to pass through untouched.

functions.name: getComposeAttachments
functions.description: Parent-scope read of the decrypted attachment model that Thunderbird built for a compose window. Thunderbird's reply compose carries the decrypted body + inline images, and (for an embedded message/rfc822 S/MIME container) may also carry standalone file attachments in nsIMsgCompFields.attachments — which the WebExtension messages API cannot reach. Returns an array of {name, size, contentType, isInline} for each non-envelope attachment part it can expose, or an empty array if none.

parameters.name: tabId
parameters.description: The messageCompose tab id whose compose window's attachments to read.

functions.name: getLastForwardUri
functions.description: Returns the message URI (e.g. imap-message://user@host/folder#uid) that the ComposeMessage hook last redirected a Forward from into a reply. Used to drive extractDecryptedAttachments with the real message. Returns null if none captured yet.

functions.name: extractDecryptedAttachments
functions.description: Parent-scope extraction of the standalone (non-inline, non-envelope) file attachments of a decrypted message, using Thunderbird's own gloda MsgHdrToMimeMessage engine with {examineEncryptedParts:true}. This descends into embedded message/rfc822 S/MIME containers that the WebExtension messages API cannot reach. Returns {rows: [{name, contentType, size, dataBase64}], log: [notes]}.

parameters.name: messageUri
parameters.description: The message URI (from getLastForwardUri) whose decryptable standalone attachments to read.

functions.name: getAndClearRedirectPending
functions.description: Returns and then clears a boolean set synchronously by the ComposeMessage hook whenever it redirected a Forward into a ReplyToSender. The background script calls this for each incoming reply compose tab to tell whether that window is the one WE redirected (must clear recipients + retitle Re:->Fwd:) versus a plain manual Reply on the same message (must be left untouched).
